name: Electronic identity issuance
description: An issuing authority identifies a person and issues a state electronic identity into their wallet.

name: Identity verification
description: A relying party checks presented identity evidence and establishes who the subject is, to the level of assurance the interaction needs.
note: Deliberately sector-neutral. Nearly every flow in the ecosystem performs this step, and separating it means each of them composes onto it instead of restating it.

name: Qualification verification
description: A relying party checks presented evidence of an education or training qualification and establishes that the subject holds it.

name: Accreditation verification
description: A relying party checks an organisation's presented accreditations and establishes that they are genuine and current.

name: Age threshold verification
description: A relying party establishes that the subject is over a stated age, learning nothing else about them.
note: Not identity verification: the outcome is an attribute, and the subject is not identified.

name: Onboarding with regulatory due diligence
description: A regulated organisation opens a relationship with a customer whose identity is already established, performs the due diligence its supervisor requires, and issues a reusable attestation that it did so.

name: Periodic due diligence re-evaluation
description: An organisation re-runs customer due diligence on an existing relationship at the interval its supervisor requires.

name: Re-identification for credential recovery
description: A customer who has lost their access credentials is re-identified before access is restored.

name: Re-identification at a change of legal capacity
description: A relationship entered at limited legal capacity is re-established at full capacity, typically on reaching majority.

name: Education qualification issuance
description: An awarding institution issues a completed education or training qualification to the graduate as a verifiable credential.
note: One pattern for gymnasiale Maturität and federal vocational certificate alike: the transformation and the interface are the same, only the awarding institution and the credential differ.

name: Tertiary admission
description: A higher education institution admits a student on established identity and qualification.

name: Employment engagement
description: An employer engages a candidate whose identity and qualifications are already established, and issues evidence of the employment relationship.
note: Split out of a single "employee identity proofing and onboarding" use case. The identity and qualification checks are separate reusable patterns; what remains here is the engagement itself.

name: Patient record matching
description: A care provider binds an identified person to the correct medical record.

name: Public service access
description: A public administration grants a resident access to an online service and establishes the entitlement that service rests on.

name: Supplier qualification
description: A buying organisation decides that a supplier with verified accreditations is eligible to be contracted, and records the decision.
